text:
anne: Quick sync — customers pushing for more flexible reserved pricing. Core asks: slab pricing (commit slabs with step discounts) vs bucket pricing (one pool, elastic pricing + overage). Thoughts?

sam: Who is pushing this? any specific ARR thresholds?

anne: CoreOps and FinServe. CoreOps wants predictable monthly spend for budgeting; FinServe needs burst headroom and explicit overage caps for compliance.

miguel: Slab model simplest to sell: pick a slab (S/M/L) -> predictable unit price. But leaves waste at edges.

rachel: Bucket gives better utilization but complicates billing and contract language + SLOs. Need clear floor/ceil and priority routing rules.

nathan: Implementationally, bucket needs dynamic routing between hosted/dedicated and fair-share. That's non-trivial for Q2.

anne: Launch criteria proposal:
- must cover 3 archetypes with examples (startup, mid-market, enterprise)
- legal-approved contract wording for overage & burst
- telemetry to show cost per token per customer
- UI in console to choose slab vs bucket

sam: For Q2 MVP, recommend slabs + optional burst add-on. Add-on = burst tokens w/ cap and priority routing for emergencies.

miguel: Agree. Burst add-on can be implemented as token wallet with algorithms for priority queueing.

rachel: Pricing example:
```
Slab S: commit 100M tokens/mo @ $0.0008/token
Slab M: commit 500M tokens/mo @ $0.00065/token
Burst pack: 50M tokens @ $0.00095/token
```

miguel: Need to run modeling. If slab jump > 25% we lose deal velocity (rough heuristic).

anne: Action items:
- miguel: run unit economics model + utilization sims by 2026-03-31
- sam: draft customer-facing slab descriptions and FAQ by 2026-04-05
- rachel: check legal on burst cap phrasing by 2026-04-02
- nathan: estimate infra changes for bucket option (rough cost & timeline)

sam: ok. I'll also ping CoreOps CSM for an example contract to align expectations.

deploy-bot: New doc created: pricing/slabs-vs-buckets-briefing (https://redwood.internal/docs/pricing/slabs-vs-buckets)

rachel: :thumbsup: Let's reconvene after modeling.
